node.title: XR rank-five rich lines force external maximal-minor zeros
node.statement: In the P-A RowC rank-five u=v=0 branch, normalize K_E to GRS_4. For a selected codeword c with residual z and chosen agreement set A, each four-set T subset A defines r_T=q-I_Tq and the exact collision line c+lambda*r_T. Other selected line members give distinct h-rich fibers of z/r_T on E\A. Equality in a fiber is exactly a vanishing 6x6 minor of the global lift (1,x,x^2,x^3,q,U). Combining with the rich-line hierarchy forces at least 23560/12600/228 distinct external vanishing-minor records per retained member on the three RowC rows. This is a representability reduction, not a slope count.
